COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), an organization/presentation locus (p0/current/n0), and a separate origin/status entry are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking processing to the same content's presentation or access.

C.rationale: Identified content (red) with explicit coordinate attribute is listed for a named referent/time.

D.rationale: A separate origin/status entry is provided for the same identified content referent, distinguishing content from provenance/status.

O.rationale: The content is presented under a structured referent ('p0/current/n0'), indicating its organization/presentation in the record.
